come_from: Antimatter Legion at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Condensed anti-matter. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
Highly condensed anti-matter within the body of the Voidranger: Trampler. The moment of obliteration is the trumpet call for civilizations' destruction.

"They are all looking forward to the moment of obliteration, when they will be reforged and fused with the entire world."

lightCones.name: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds

name: Silvermane Badge
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Pin badge worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
It is full of scratches from the erosion of wind and snow.

"In ancient times, there was only one way Silvermane Guards could retire: Death."

lightCones.name: In the Name of the World

name: Silvermane Insignia
come_from: Everwinter Shadewalker and Incineration Shadewalker at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Silvermane Guards and vagrants at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Military rank insignia worn by captains of the Silvermane Guard. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
Maybe it's a proof of heroics that you can brag about to your family. Maybe it's a lucky charm that protects you from a bullet.

"Times have changed."

lightCones.name: In the Name of the World

name: Silvermane Medal
come_from: Everwinter Shadewalker and Incineration Shadewalker at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Silvermane Guards and vagrants at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters.
It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin.

"Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."

lightCones.name: In the Name of the World

name: Ancient Part
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Mechanical part left behind from the Old World. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
Despite its size, it was cast and polished in a way that people today would struggle to replicate.

"A small screw in the Old World is stronger than our armor."

name: Ancient Spindle
come_from: Automatons at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Mechanical spindle left behind from the Old World. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
Once taken apart, the precision components can never be put back together. Even the maintenance veterans in Belobog's Technology Division would think twice before touching it.

"You idiot, the Bluecoats will only give you a few canned goods for this. Take it to Boss Svarog and you won't need to worry about food and clothing for a while."

name: Ancient Engine
come_from: Automatons at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
It uses Geomarrow as the energy source. When powered, it spews wandering auroras, not sparkles.

"Only the Technology Division directly under the Supreme Guardian has access to information regarding the Old World. I lost my privileges after I was fired."

name: Immortal Scionette
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: New and young shoot budding from an ancient divine construct. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "infinite lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. Countless years ago, a sovereign's hubris for immortality caused the Xianzhou fleet to sail into the sea of outer space to seek divine recipes.

"We desire to live for endless ages and maintain the empire for all eternity. Unfortunately, human lives have limits and human capacity has its ends. Thus, we send nine Navis Astrigera to sail beyond the sky, seeking divine recipes for immortality."

lightCones.name: I Shall Be My Own Sword

name: Immortal Aeroblossom
come_from: Abominations of Abundance at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.

"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

lightCones.name: I Shall Be My Own Sword

name: Immortal Lumintwig
come_from: Abominations of Abundance at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Deciduous twigs from an ancient divine construct. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After the Three Sufferings, Xianzhou laid in devastation. The Homo celestinae fell as demons, and catastrophes occurred ceaselessly.

"As decreed by the Ten-Lords Commission, all who are near the mara-struck state will be seized by the infernal judges and cast into the Shackling Prison."

lightCones.name: I Shall Be My Own Sword

name: Artifex's Module
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
The foundation of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The smallest constituent of all machine parts. Breaking it apart would be akin to destroying the cellular structure of a living being.

"The Intelligentsia Guild put up a bounty of two million credits for technical plans that can flawlessly disassemble Xianzhou mechanical puppets."
"If you know Screwllum, then these two millions are basically yours to take..."

lightCones.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

name: Artifex's Cogwheel
come_from: Entranced Ingenia at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Parts of the Xianzhou machines. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
The connective components used in Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The intricate and thin teeth of the cogwheels are as minute as mustard seeds, and yet are interconnected to form a complex body, making the machine able to pass as true life.

"Its form lies in harmony, a parallel to nature. Its movements cyclical, echoing the cosmos."

lightCones.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

name: Artifex's Gyreheart
come_from: Entranced Ingenia at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
The core of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The armillary sphere roils and vibrates like the essence of a heart, making the machine think like a living being.

"Do not be startled. Taking away its heart would make him... her?... No, make it lose its sentience and return to its mechanical sources."

lightCones.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

name: Dream Collection Component
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: A storage device for Dreamscape creations. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
A storage device for broken dreams, providing a fundamental energy source for Dreamscape creations.

"Install this device, and you will get a member of the Sweet Dreams Troupe."

name: Dream Flow Valve
come_from: Dreamjolt Troupe at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: A control component for Dreamscape creations. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
A dream-building device that regulates desires and controls the Dreamscape creations' emotions.

"If this device fails, you will get a member of the Dreamjolt Troupe."

name: Dream Making Engine
come_from: Dreamjolt Troupe at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: An energy core for Dreamscape creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
A dream-building device that constructs fantasies and grants souls to Dreamscape creations.

"If this device malfunctions... try to wake up before you descend into a nightmare, my friend."

name: Tatters of Thought
come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: A memoria fragment of fleeting thought. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
Within the Memory Zone, thousands of thoughts flutter like dust. Broken thoughts accumulate, serving as nourishment and components for memes.

"A fleeting thought may dissipate into thin air or amass into obsessions."

name: Fragments of Impression
come_from: Memory Zone Meme at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: A memoria fragment of profound impression. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
Within the Memory Zone, the form of memories float as fleeting glimmers of light, and only profound and memorable fragments can condense it crystals.

"Memory is not a mere replication of past sensations, but a reconstruction of past impressions."

name: Shards of Desires
come_from: Memory Zone Meme at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
desc: A memoria fragment of obsessive desires. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
Within the Memory Zone, memoria of desires develops ceaselessly. It absorbs thoughts and impressions, nurtures magic mirrors of desires, and reflects the eerie shadows of memetic entities.

"Memory points to the past, while desire points to the future. To seek desires from memory will cause dreams to become inverted, and inner demons will naturally be born."

name: Fear-Stomped Flesh
desc: Dust that forms the Strife Titankins. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
The tide of death sweeps across the world, and giants of hatred and resentment step forth from the River of Souls. All fear and cower before that stone-carved legion.

"Slaughter is the stone from which fear is hewn."

lightCones.name: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path
Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

name: Courage-Torn Chest
come_from: Titankin at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Crepuscular Beasts at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
desc: A fragment of the Strife Titankins after their demise. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
The slothful generals began to drill, and the reclusive sages began to plot. Then humanity discovered they could shatter the creations of gods, and slaughter became war.

"Fear is the chisel of courage."

lightCones.name: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path
Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

name: Glory-Aspersed Torso
come_from: Titankin at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
Crepuscular Beasts at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
desc: The heart of a Strife Titankin, full of divine power. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
In the beginning, humanity fought wars to stay alive, but now some fight as fearlessly as the Titankins of Strife to achieve death. The Kremnoans say that perhaps warriors of flesh and stone share the same heart —

"And this heart is called glory, with courage flowing within."

lightCones.name: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path
Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

name: Ethereal Omen
desc: A fragment dropped by black tide creatures. Crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
Misfortune often creeps in quietly, and by the time you perceive it, it has already swelled into a calamity that engulfs the world.

"The death knell sounds at destiny's cessation."

lightCones.name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

name: Echoing Wail
come_from: Black Tide Creatures at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
desc: A fractured carapace from black tide creatures. Normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
Grotesque heads roar, ragged blades keen enough to sunder all, while the genesis of the scourge still lurks, veiled in the shadows and shrouded by the mists of death.

"Why do you lament alone at the gravestone?"

lightCones.name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

name: Eternal Lament
come_from: Black Tide Creature at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
desc: A crystal born from the demise of black tide creatures. Advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
Born of the void and destined to return to the void. A contorted existence wrought by decay, fated to wander the desolate earth purposelessly.

"Its life is one of ruin and sorrow."

lightCones.name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

name: Whimsy Wax
desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A crude material used for enhancement.
lore:
In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else."
"No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't."
The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes."
Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child.
For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world.

"With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

lightCones.name: A Star That Lights the Night
See You at the World's End!

name: Dreamweave Steel
come_from: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 2
desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
lore:
Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?"
The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did."
Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence.
Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality.
Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind.

"With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

lightCones.name: A Star That Lights the Night
See You at the World's End!

name: Lucid Awl
come_from: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 4
desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. An advanced material used for enhancement.
lore:
Every story worth taking seriously shares the same theme: "How to live the one life we're given."
Life is so short that even the greatest sages are suddenly tossed into this world, forced to experience a lifetime without any preparation. That is why no one ever lives a perfect life. There are always regrets, always moments wasted.
But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. And in stories, we can reach immortality from within our finite cages.

"With stories, we are able to live a thousand lifetimes."

lightCones.name: A Star That Lights the Night
See You at the World's End!

name: Hertareum
desc: The cryptocurrency circulating internally in the Herta Space Station. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
lore:
Hertareum was planned as a digital currency, but eventually settled as a physical currency.
It's worth mentioning that even though Hertareum coins don't contain any precious metal components, the high-definition silhouette Non-Fungible Token contained inside it is much more valuable than any of them.

name: Shield
desc: The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
lore:
After a long era of blockades, the Overworld and Underworld denizens of Belobog have developed vastly different standards for currency.
The current exchange rate of shield to credits is now 1:50... Speaking of, why are credits still an official currency of Belobog? It seems people have already forgotten the answer to this question.

name: Strale
desc: The internal currency of the Xianzhou Alliance with strales as its basic monetary unit. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
lore: The Xianzhou strales have long been digitized before Xianzhou's interactions with the IPC ever happened. However, there are some collectors who still kept the Celest-Gold coins minted when the Alliance first came into existence. Shaped like the tip of an arrow or a narrow leaf, it seems to allude to the past and future of that civilization.

name: Clock Credits
desc: This is said to be a commemorative currency issued personally by the Watchmaker. Can only be used at the Clockie Statue.
lore: A mysterious banknote, whose origin is unknown even to The Family. It features the classic image of Clockie on the front. This currency is prohibited for regular transactions in the Dreamscape world, and only a few people know its true purpose.

name: Celestial Ambrosia
desc: It was said that even Titans covet this ambrosial libation. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
lore: The absolute finest of Amphoreus' thousand ambrosias. A golden, sweet nectar. It is said to come from the divine corpus of the Chalice of Plenty spilled onto the earth, making it the perfect offering to the Titans. Just a few drops are enough to inebriate a mortal with its rich fragrance. Consuming it on its own leads to unconsciousness, as if one is drowning in a vast ocean.

name: Disorder Ambrosia
desc: A liquid that exists outside temporal order. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
lore: A precious drink that was once considered "Celestial Ambrosia" in worldly cognition. As the cycles of Amphoreus were revealed, so did the truth of this drink. The scent wafting out of the bottle's mouth seems even more intense and sweeter than before, but imbibing is still not recommended.

name: Arcadian Token
desc: A commemorative coin used in Planarcadia and Astropolis, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.
lore:
The local currency of Planarcadia, minted and issued by the Wishpower Bank after being infused with Wishpower. The front depicts various imagenae living together in harmony. In the face of a digital economy, the Arcadian Token maintains its prestigious status among tourists and collectors for its unique blend of cultural sentiment and economic value.
Pursuant to the "Vehicle City Accord" ratified in Year 1985 of the Arcadian Calendar, universal equivalents tied to Wishpower are permitted to circulate in Astropolis as well.

name: Lil' Twisty Bubble Gum
desc: A tasty and cheap Punklorde snack. Can be used to Superimpose the Light Cone "Before the Tutorial Mission Starts."
lore:
A candy favored by a certain Stellaron Hunter. It contains rocket tree gum, and the crispy sound of bubbles popping is absolutely irresistible.

"Pop!"

name: Exorcismal Fulu
desc: The special talisman used by the Ten-Lords Commission to suppress heliobi. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Hey, Over Here."
lore: "Decree of Nine Chapters, myriad spirits concealed."

name: Clockwork Inspiration Notebook
desc: A handbook that contains the Watchmaker's inspiration for his works. Can be used for the Superimposition of the Light Cone "For Tomorrow's Journey."
lore: The initial director of Dreamjoy Memoir left this on the desk. It's filled with messy drafts, cryptic wording, indecipherable handwriting, and a Clockie's smile... The contents of this handbook bear the past of an entire world.

name: Music Disc
desc: The disc used during a band's performance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Ninja Record: Sound Hunt."
lore: "The best way to record memories."

name: Physical Game Cartridge
desc: A plug-and-play cartridge. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Great Cosmic Enterprise."
lore: Even with today's advanced data transfer technology, some developers still prefer cartridges as their game medium, just like writers savoring the sensation of pen on paper.

name: Chrysos Spoon
desc: A legendary cooking utensil used by fairies. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Forever Victual."
lore: "—With the power to control most of the Membrance Maze!"

name: Flawed Recollection
desc: A flawed, fragile crystalline flower of Remembrance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Fly Into a Pink Tomorrow."
lore: "That genuine shiver when crystal flowers fall... That's the 'mover of life.'"

name: Commemorative Cartridge
desc: A game cartridge featuring the Baseball Raccoon avatar, the proof of a popular streamer. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone: "Tomorrow, Together."
lore: "A game we all produced together."

name: Celebration Champagne
desc: The crisp pop of a champagne cork is like a victory salute. Can superimpose the Light Cone "Race to the Horizon."
lore:
In the euphoria of victory, it is uncorked atop the podium, shaken, and sent spraying into the sky. A fragrant, fruity rain.

"Pop!"

name: Aideen Tokens
lore:
A token for amusement facilities at Aideen Park. Despite their large size, they are exceptionally lightweight.

Q: What is something that the more you possess, the less wealth you have? A: Gambler's chips.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Forgotten Hall
desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Forgotten Hall this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Pure Fiction
desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Pure Fiction this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Apocalyptic Shadow
desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Apocalyptic Shadow this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Anomaly Arbitration Limited-Time Clearance Medal
desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in the King Stage of Anomaly Arbitration of this period.
lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Access Card
desc: Can be used to open the Relic Chest in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
lore: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

name: Jing Yuan's Affinitive Eidolon
desc: Material for activating Jing Yuan's Affinitive Eidolon.
lore: An Eidolon born of a mysterious fate, and selected from countless coincidences.

name: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's Affinitive Eidolon
desc: Material for activating Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's Affinitive Eidolon.
lore: An Eidolon born of a mysterious fate, and selected from countless coincidences.

name: Acheron's Affinitive Eidolon
desc: Material for activating Acheron's Affinitive Eidolon.
lore: An Eidolon born of a mysterious fate, and selected from countless coincidences.

name: Solid Water
come_from: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. 
Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry.

"...Isn't it ice?"
"No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state."
"...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

name: Basic Ingredients
come_from: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal.
Not particularly good, but is edible.

"Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

name: Phlogiston
come_from: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Particles that form the flame.
Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it.
#7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence.

"Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

name: Metal
come_from: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean.
Very useful, very handy.

"I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

name: Gaseous Liquid
come_from: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Is it fog, rain, or wind?
You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid.

"The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..."
"The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

name: Seed
come_from: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Reproductive units unique to plants.
Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good.

"Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

name: Discarded Ingenium Parts
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.

"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

name: Human-Height Auspicious Crops
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.

"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

name: Tranquility
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.

"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: Broken Dreams
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony.
They once belonged to broken hearts.

"In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Rusty Gear
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.

"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
desc: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
lore:
A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. 

"If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!"
"...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

name: Mechanical Parts
come_from: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions.
Without them, nothing can be made.

"With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day."
"Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

name: Virtual Particle
come_from: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory.
Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality.

"I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

name: Protein Rice
come_from: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives.
Smooth as egg white and full of protein.

"Every grain costs sweat and blood."

name: Feather of Flame
come_from: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip.
Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around.

"The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

name: Core of Ice
come_from: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Shattered ice fallen from the stars.
The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime.

"Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

name: Eye of Lightning
come_from: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
An electric ball made from captured lightning.
If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball.

"A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

name: Vortex of Wind
come_from: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
The eye of the storm remains stagnant.
Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm.

"Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?"
"Trailblazing!"
"...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

name: Quantum Ripples
come_from: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Ripples in the Sea of Quanta.
Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation.

"Time, there's so much time."
"All the time there is."

name: Leaf of Imaginary
come_from: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
A leaf of unknown origin.
It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract.
The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power.

"One leaf, one world."

name: Meteoric Alloy
come_from: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Resilient meteoric ironsand.
Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders.

"Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them."
"I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

name: Jade Abacus Unit
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.

"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

name: Extract of Medicinal Herbs
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.

"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

name: Tian Dong
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.

"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

name: Confounding
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.

"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

name: Hunger
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible.
In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death.

"They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

name: Old Molar
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.

"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

name: Bough of Thought
come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. 

"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

name: Deep Marrow Rock Salt
come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
desc: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
lore:
Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. 

"Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

name: Strange Matter of Destruction
come_from: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction.
Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds.
Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash.

"Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

name: Ambergris of Abundance
come_from: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance.
Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip.
Do not ask what it's made of.

"It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

name: Stone of The Hunt
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Small stone with the power of The Hunt.
As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction.
Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not.

"The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

name: Preservation Construction Material
come_from: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation.
When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard.
Please do not use together with Solid Water.

"I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature."
"I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

name: Hard Chip of Nihility
come_from: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility.
It may have been a coin that people use to buy things.
But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them.

"I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

name: Tree Bark of Erudition
come_from: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition.
Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature.
It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking.

"The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

name: Slime of Harmony
come_from: Stargazer Navalia: Entranced Ingenium: Obedient Dracolion or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony.
It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination.
A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go.

"All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

name: Dragon Scale Coral
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound.
In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads:

"When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

name: The Sound and the Fury
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations.
Don't let these distractions sway your judgment.

"Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

name: Thermal Gel
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.

"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

name: Silk Spindle
come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
desc: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
lore:
A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.

"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

name: Interdimensional Leaf
come_from: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous.
For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere.

"Wow."

name: Phase Flame
come_from: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change.
What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame.

"Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

name: Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
come_from: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.

"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

name: Mythus Knots
come_from: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.

"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

name: Weary
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.

"This is what is called 'weariness.'"

name: Mechanical Cube
come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.

"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

name: Fresh Seed of Dawn
come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
desc: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
lore:
Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful.
When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant.
Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title.

"Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?"
"Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."

Don't forget our duty mission no matter what: Act the fastest, execute the swiftest, use your strengths to the max, and don't stop polishing your work till perfection hits! Keep that motivation high! I've prepared some suuuuuper awesome rewards for you!

desc: After obtaining Phone Wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function

"Welcome to Penacony, the Planet of Festivities!"
"We wish you a wonderful holiday in the Dreamscape!"

name: Cosmodyssey
desc: After obtaining Phone wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function

"The 'Trailblaze' will not end."
"Let's head toward the shimmering stars together!"

"Hi everyone. Sorry I'm late, but that's not important. The weekly report for the Simulated Universe's new version is here. Let's hotfix any issues, and if there are no issues, we can adjourn."
"The data for Path grouping seems to have some deviation... However, the performance of the new research samples is acceptable."
"Conclusion: The research samples are showing signs of developing self-awareness, which poses significant risks. Adjustments should be made."

name: Moment of Triumph
come_from: Phone Wallpaper obtained after the Luminary Wardance event

lore:
"Yanqing, I wonder when we'll meet again. When that time comes, how about we have another exhilarating match?"
"Mr. Luka's thoughts are no different from mine. I accept this challenge! Looking forward to our next duel!"

come_from: Phone Wallpaper obtained after the Cosmic Home Décor Guide event
desc: After obtaining Phone wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.
lore: Cheers, friend! A toast to your new abode, united will, and white nights full of joy.

"How about now, Owlbert?"
"Chow about... burgers... so tasty..."
"It's Thursday, and you're still dreaming of burgers? Get to work, or your annual performance review might be at risk!"

name: The Coming Dawn

lore: The journey of Flame-Chase is fraught with thorns. Break free from the darkness in which one hides, and keep on marching forward until one touches the first ray before the daybreak!

name: Next To You
desc: After obtaining Phone wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.
lore:
"No matter how many nights this world shall see!"
"No matter how arduous the times may be, we'll always be here with you!"

name: A Taste of Happiness
come_from: Phone Wallpaper obtained after the "Chrysos Maze Grand Restaurant" event
desc: After obtaining Phone Wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.
lore:
"Yummy... It's so yummy I can't stop eating~!"
"I wish I could have delicious food every day, then my tummy wouldn't be so empty~!"

name: The Weight of a Reward
come_from: Phone Wallpaper obtained from "Furbobocom" Welfare Level Rewards
desc: After obtaining Phone wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.
lore:
"Everyone, come here! Our boss is furnally paying us a salary!!!"
"Waaaah! Our boss was right! Hard work pays off-fur!"
"Do your furbest at work in the future! Let's not work hard today!"

name: Deliverer's Wreath
desc: A wreath that Amphoreus offered to {NICKNAME}.
lore:
The laurel leaves praise your wisdom, the gold reflects your nobility, and this stands as proof that you once belonged here.

"From this day forth, your name shall no longer be your own alone, mortals will swear by your name.
Wear this glorious yet lonely laurel crown, hero... and merge into the pages of the epic."

name: Garbdriver
come_from: Trailblaze Fashion obtained after the "Snack Dash" event
desc: A hairpin modeled after one of Ruan Mei's creations.
lore:
There might have been many noble trash cakes in history, and you just wish you could all go anywhere together...

"Pat the left paw to turn left, pat the right paw to turn right. Pat the tail to brake. Let's go!"

name: Hello Mem World!
come_from: Trailblaze Fashion obtained from past Cherished Recollection event
desc: A plush, Mem-styled hood.
lore:
"They say that at amusement parks on other planets, cute animal friends are always a kid's favorite."
"This Mem hood is gonna be a bestseller for sure!"
"Hmm, but doesn't it make the wearer look a little... puffy?"

name: Aw, Look Up Here
come_from: Obtained from the Fashion Item store
desc: A holographic screen prop that hovers above the head, featuring a built-in set of "emoti" expressions that play on random shuffle.
lore:
"Trailblazer, what do you make of this?"

"Aw, don't look at me, look up."

name: Ah! Youth!
come_from: Trailblaze Fashion obtained from the "Cosmicon, Roll On!" event
desc: A headpiece modeled after the wispae "Golden Youth." People's regrets over unfinished business from their youth have coalesced into this little guy.
lore:
Ten years later, you can't bring yourself to open that tiny gift box you'd long forgotten. You worry there might be an unopened letter inside, but you're equally afraid it's just a gift.

"I still remember running beneath the sunset that day... that was the youth I lost!"

name: Sparkly Rabbit and Fire Shroom
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: Adorable headband styled after Sparkly Rabbit and Fire Shroom.
lore:
A popular product from Sparxie's livestream. According to some Sparxheads, it occasionally makes a "Mwah!" sound.

"Whoa, it even makes sounds! Sparxie really puts her heart into these!"
"Huh... Oh... So that's how it is... Hahaha!"

name: Loading
come_from: Obtained from the Fashion Item store
desc: The classic "Loading" icon you see everywhere, now with some snazzy light effects.
lore:
When it hangs over your head, it buys you a little more time for reflection.

"Trailblazer, what do you think?"

name: Raccoon Supplicant Mask
come_from: Trailblaze Fashion obtained from the "Furbobocom" Bestseller Rank Rewards
desc: An origami mask styled like a raccoon. Handle with care.
lore:
A temporary Supplicant mask designed by Evanescia for {NICKNAME}, in a raccoon style befitting only the protagonist.

Now come. Let me make you... more of a "{RUBY_B#raccoon}protagonist{RUBY_E#}."

name: Universal Popularity Crown: Neon Cat-ear Headphones
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: A pair of futuristic cat-ear headphones with a bold, adorable design, glowing with a signature pink neon light. The perfect proof that you've made it as a top streamer.
lore: "Since you've decided to become the Astral Express's official game streamer, then... hehe, put these headphones on! Mm-hmm! Not bad, not bad. You're really starting to look the part! Pink totally suits you too, just like I said it would."

name: Little Raccoon Goes Full Evanefox
come_from: Obtained from the Fashion Item store
desc: A pair of tall, slender pink fox ears set on a headband, their edges adorned with delicate silver metal accents and crafted with exceptional care.
lore:
Evanescia has long made a habit of wearing The Fluffy's matching headpiece, happily roaming conventions. Still, nothing compares to seeing her idol wearing the pink fox ears that represent her.

"Wait... that's my look... It is, right!? I'm not imagining this? *click*! That's way too cute! Okay, one more shot! I'm printing this and keeping it by my bed!"

name: Furbobo Goggles
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: Featuring a wide frame and eye-catching orange-tinted lenses, these Furbobocom special-issue goggles are made to protect your eyes in the chaos of breaking news on site.
lore:
A go-to piece of gear for furbo journalist Furbulitzer, its oversized lenses said to be especially effective at blocking coworkers' jealous stares.

"So it's leading the Press Corps, and even the president's wearing the same pair? Beepboop, that was the wrong call..."

name: Cool Overload Shades
come_from: Obtained from the Fashion Item store
desc: With translucent, multicolored lenses and blue-pink flame effects along the edges, these retro arcade-style glasses are, by appearance alone, almost a perfect 1:1 match to the original.
lore: "So you were expecting HP bars, weaknesses, and loot to pop up? Yeah... no. They're just plain goggles with a holographic filter."

name: Karmic Fire of the Distant Shore
desc: A ring formed of three clusters of karmic fire. When equipped, it hovers behind the wearer as a back accessory.
lore: The flames of wrath ignite, proclaiming that he has cast aside his obsessions and vowed to point his honed blade — forged in rebirth and tempered a thousand times into its sharpest form — directly at the source of all tragedy.

name: Fan-Made Lygus
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: A fan-made headwear exclusive to the Star Rail FEST booth. Its cool, restrained color palette and meticulous craftsmanship perfectly recreate the character's iconic face-covering design.
lore:
A heartfelt creation from a hospitable stall owner, pressed into your hands in hopes of winning over yet another fan.

"Take this freebie, and we're officially kindred spirits! Go on, try it on!"

name: Lone Wolf Shades
come_from: Trailblaze Fashion obtained from the "Love, Ghosts & Robots" event
desc: Sunglasses of the same model as Lyndon Skott's. Capable of blocking ultraviolet rays, harmful cosmic microwave background radiation, hostile stares, and tears of loneliness.
lore: "No friends, no enemies, only prey."

name: Trainee Angel
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: An exquisitely crafted golden halo hovers overhead, flanked by a pair of small white wings that radiate a saintly glow.
lore: Put this on, lie back serenely on a couch with your arms neatly folded over your chest, and enjoy the priceless look of sheer horror on your friends' faces as they push open the door.

name: Generating Mischief
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: A classic little glass light bulb that occasionally flickers on. Its power source is unknown, though rumor has it that it runs on the inspiration inside the wearer's head.
lore:
"Passenger, why is the light bulb on your head glowing? I'm warning you, do not wreck the Express."
"Aaaah, don't come closer with that creepy smile!"

name: Phantasmoon Star Rail
come_from: Available at the Phantasia Showstage event
desc: Along a circular trail of light, silver-white moon phases are arranged one after another, enacting the waxing and waning of the Phantasmoon... a performance that never takes its final bow.
lore: The moon waxes and wanes, and the stars shift. On your boundless journey into the future, whenever you look up at the sea of stars and see a new moon rise, you will always reminisce about the absurdity and miracles you shared with a particular Aeon.

name: Elation Proxy
desc: A red-and-black circus-style signpost headpiece, its surface shimmering with a dazzling glint. The indicator arrow points straight down, always locking on to the wearer themselves.
lore: "We Emanators of Elation don't do attendance checks, don't do performance reviews. No KPIs, period!"

name: Yellow-Purple Style
come_from: Obtained from the "Claim Your Parcel" event
desc: The hem of the white jacket is accented with a comic-style grid pattern, and a smug-looking little raccoon is featured on the inner outfit with a yellow-to-purple gradient. Wear this outfit, and you'll feel like the main character of a comic wherever you go.
lore: "Trailblazer, which planet's fashion trend is this?"

name: Vim and Vigor
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: Features a black base with gold embroidery, with dragon patterns adorning the lapels and back, and traditional frog button closures on the inner garment.
lore:
Upon seeing your confusion, Dan Heng explains the origin of this outfit.

"The Xianzhou has long held the tradition of welcoming each new year with fresh attire and renewed hopes. May the coming year bring you health without harm, friends without ills, and heaven's favor in all things."

name: Aether Spirit Upgrade Data
desc: A data chip used to increase Aether Spirit levels in the Aetherium Wars.
lore: It was rumored that in the earliest version of Aetherium Wars, only the first Aether Spirit who battled can obtain experience, until the emergence of this chip which greatly reduced the grinding time needed for players.

name: Road of the Mundanite
desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the starting Cosmic Fragments in the Divergent Universe increases by 20.
lore:
"The lost seeker found traces of truth in the mist. And so, he set off for the material world."

— Fables About the Stars by Adrian Spencer Smith

name: Herta: Collector's Edition
desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Divergent Universe Curio store in Store Domains will increase the amount of purchasable Curios by 1.
lore: The great Madam Herta. Even as her puppet, its every action is still suffused with the brilliance of intellect.

name: Pursuit's End
desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Heat usable for Blessing Enhancement increases by 1 point in the Divergent Universe First Plane's Workbench of Creation.
lore: The infinite layers of nutshells encase the ruler of the infinite universe, yet even so, she continues to turn the key, opening the next door infinitely.

name: Dr. Ratio — Bespoke Version
desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the amount of Cosmic Fragments needed to overwrite Equations in the Divergent Universe's Workbench of Creation decreases by 10.
lore:
So you're saying that Professor Ratio, whose pass rate is like the gacha rates in the Interastral Peace Entertainment's blind boxes, actually passed you? Stop pulling my leg.
...
What, are you serious?

name: Hero's Trail
desc: After this item is placed in the Probability Museum, your team will recover 2 Technique Points after entering a Boss Domain in Divergent Universe.
lore:
"What are you carving on the tombstone, one-eyed poet?"
"Proof of our existence."

name: Mem (Cuter Version)
desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, receive 1 attempt to reset Blessings for free in the Divergent Universe Third Plane's Workbench of Creation.
lore: Hey, don't rub my tail when I'm asleep!

lore: The sheath of Excalibur faintly visible within the illusion, is like the continuation of a dream.

name: Command Spell Umbra

lore: A crystal relief modeled after Command Spells, engraved with the hero's past.
